features.name: value_bp
features.description: log book-to-price from the latest filing visible at t (filing date + 1 day)

features.name: value_ep
features.description: earnings yield: trailing earnings / market cap from the latest visible filing

features.name: mom_12_1
features.description: 12-1 month momentum: return from t-252 to t-21 trading days

features.name: mom_6_1
features.description: 6-1 month momentum: return from t-126 to t-21 trading days

features.name: mom_change
features.description: change of 12-1 momentum over the last 63 trading days

features.name: industry_momentum
features.description: cap-weighted mean 6-1 momentum of the name's industry (eligible names at t)

features.name: quality_gpa
features.description: gross profitability: gross profits / total assets (latest visible filing)

features.name: investment_ag
features.description: minus year-over-year total-asset growth (low investment scores high)

features.name: beta_252
features.description: 252-day rolling beta on the equal-weighted return of the eligible names

features.name: idio_vol_252
features.description: 252-day residual volatility of that beta regression (daily)

features.name: max_ret_21
features.description: largest daily return of the last 21 trading days (lottery demand)

features.name: turnover_63
features.description: 63-day mean of dollar volume / market cap

features.name: amihud_63
features.description: log 63-day mean Amihud illiquidity |return| / dollar volume

features.name: log_dollar_vol_63
features.description: log 63-day mean dollar volume (as-traded price x shares traded)

features.name: log_mcap
features.description: log market capitalisation

features.name: short_interest
features.description: short interest / shares outstanding (where the store has it)

features.name: borrow_fee
features.description: annualised stock-borrow fee (where the store has it)

features.name: strev_21
features.description: short-term reversal: minus the 21-day return, demeaned within industry

features.name: ear_3d
features.description: earnings announcement return over [p-1, p+1] minus the market, visible from p+2

features.name: sue
features.description: standardised unexpected EPS (seasonal random walk, trailing 8 quarters), filing + 1 day

features.name: days_since_earnings
features.description: trading days since the last visible announcement, capped at 126 (conditioning)

features.name: abn_volume_5d
features.description: log of 5-day mean dollar volume over the 252-day mean before it

features.name: abn_volume_earn
features.description: log dollar volume around the last announcement over its 252-day base

features.name: accruals
features.description: Sloan accruals: (net income - operating cash flow) / average assets (TTM filing)

features.name: net_issuance
features.description: minus the 252-day log growth of split-adjusted shares (Daniel-Titman issuance)

features.name: high_52w
features.description: close / its 252-day high, in (0, 1] (George-Hwang 52-week high)
